text:
In June 2026 Düsseldorf’s median asking rent stood at 14.45 €/m², up 4.1 % year‑on‑year and 29.6 % over the past five years, placing the city eighth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The rent premium over existing contracts is 56 % (9.24 €/m² in the 2022 census), while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 867 € per month.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and listings staying on the market for an average of 26 days; 29 % are let within a week, indicating moderate tightness. Rent‑burden for two residents is 16 % of income, reflecting limited affordability despite modest mortgage rates of 4.01 %.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 15.32 €/m² in the next 12 months, within a range of 14.91 – 15.55 €/m², implying a further 6 % rise.
